title: La Danta and El Tigre, oldest Maya pyramids
summary: Luke Caverns tells of La Danta and El Tigre, oldest Maya pyramids, about ancient Maya at El Mirador, Guatemala, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: That is the first known pyramid in it's called Ladanta. Ladanta and Ligra.

plain: A researcher who goes by Luke Caverns says that at El Mirador, an ancient Maya site in Guatemala, stand two great pyramids called La Danta and El Tigre. He describes them as the first known pyramids of the Maya, which matters to him because it would push back the story of how and when pyramid building began.
